hazards.control: Pressure test before opening to the well; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.
Stay clear of the coil path, the gooseneck, and flowback iron under flow.

name: Control cabin
function: The operator station with the weight indicator, depth counter, circulating and wellhead pressure gauges, and the controls for injector, reel, stripper, and BOP.

tabs.overview: Depth is counted at the injector and corrected for stretch; weight comes from the injector load cell; the BOP panel has its own accumulator.
tabs.safety: The cabin is outside the stack drop zone; emergency BOP functions are on a dedicated panel.
tabs.evidence: Public coiled tubing pressure control guide (S24), API RP 16ST and API RP 5C7 scope (S23, S26), field practice (S9).
